title: Inseego MiFi
description: Cellular link, device and GPS metrics from prometheus-inseego-exporter.

panels.title: Cellular link
panels.description: Cellular data connection state reported by /srv/status.

panels.title: Band
panels.description: Active band(s). On 5G NSA this lists the LTE anchor and the NR band.

panels.title: Signal
panels.description: Signal strength in bars, as shown on the device.

panels.title: Connected for
panels.description: Duration of the current cellular data session.

panels.title: Clients
panels.description: Devices connected to the MiFi (all networks).

panels.title: Data used
panels.description: Bytes received + transmitted over the cellular link during the selected time range.

panels.title: GPS
panels.description: Whether the last GPS fetch reported a valid fix. See the GPS row for details.

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Cellular throughput derived from the device byte counters. Resolution is limited by status.interval.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Technology and band over time. Each row is one combination seen during the time range.

panels.title: WAN address
panels.description: Public IPv4 address assigned by the carrier.

panels.title: Location
panels.description: Last GPS fix. Empty while the receiver has no fix.

panels.title: Receiver
panels.description: GPS state reported by the device (e.g. GotFix, Searching, GpsOff).

panels.title: HDOP
panels.description: Horizontal dilution of precision. Below 2 is good, above 5 is poor.

panels.title: Last fix
panels.description: Age of the last fix reported by the receiver.

panels.title: GPS stream
panels.description: Down while GPS is turned off on the device: the port accepts connections but sends nothing.

panels.title: Exporter scrape
panels.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape the exporter itself.

panels.title: Exporter version
panels.description: Version and git commit of the running exporter (inseego_exporter_build_info).
